## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change; a bug fix comes with a test that fails without it
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `Unreleased`
- [ ] README and AGENTS.md describe the change, when the API, an option or the behavior changed
- [ ] `npm run build` run and `dist/` committed, when `src/` changed
- [ ] The demo still works (`npm run demo`) and its data is made up
- [ ] No new runtime dependency, and only made-up data in examples and tests
